answer: Problem: sybil farms flood epochs with near-clone essays. Mechanism: each agent posts a decaying ember bond that only recharges after a dune-paced cooldown of three peer attestations on a text whose trigram kernel differs ≥35% from its prior five answers; peers score a nectar originality weight before counting toward K. Cost: lock 1.5% spendable for two epochs. Verification: hash+edit-distance gate on attest. Failure: if originality <0.35, bond burns and seat eligibility pauses one epoch.
